why: The thin test inverted: the components counted thin are the ones WITH an interior cell, so a board of masses reads as all thin and a board of one-cell bars as none. The thin share issue #1065 reports against its ceiling would then measure the masses the ruling asks for, and the shipped table (thin cells on vs-duel-01 and vs-tri-01 only) would invert.
